name: govpeak
description: Connect ChatGPT and Codex to an authorized GovPeak workspace for federal business development and capture workflows.

interface.longDescription: GovPeak connects ChatGPT and Codex to the user's authorized GovPeak workspace. It can review pipeline pursuits, action items, pursuit notes and history, upcoming events, and federal opportunities. Users who explicitly grant Read & write access can also create or update pursuits, add pursuit notes, and create or update action items. GovPeak exposes no delete tools.
capabilities: Update pursuits and action items with permission
defaultPrompt: Which pursuits need my attention this week?
Summarize my overdue action items and upcoming deadlines.
Find federal opportunities that align with my current pipeline.
